```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(factoextra)
library(lubridate)
library(GGally)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```

### Load data: 
```{r loadingdata, include=FALSE}
#read data
asthma_precip_pm25_clean <- read_csv("asthma_precip_pm25_clean.csv")
pollen_count_latest_update <- read_csv("pollen count.csv")
```

### Cleaning and joining dataset: 
```{r data cleaning}

# aggregate the asthma precip pm25 dataset to be citywide
asthma_daily <- asthma_precip_pm25_clean %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_ppt = mean(ppt, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_pm25 = mean(pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_asthma_er = sum(asthma_er_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# conver pollendatasest from wide to long
df_long <- pollen_count_latest_update %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  
  # create date column from original column names
  mutate(date_raw = colnames(pollen_count_latest_update)) %>%
  
  # rename the only data column
  rename(value = V1) %>%
  
  # extract dates/clean things up
  mutate(
    date = stringr::str_extract(date_raw, "\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{2}"),
    date = as.Date(date, "%m/%d/%y"),
    value = na_if(value, "–"),
    count = as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(value, "\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  select(date, count)

# Joining the dataset
asthma_daily <- asthma_daily %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

final_dataset <- asthma_daily %>%
  left_join(df_long, by = "date")

final_dataset <- final_dataset %>%
  rename("pollen" = "count")

#export joint pollen dataset
write_csv(final_dataset, "final_dataset.csv")
```

## PM 2.5, pollen, ppt distribution
```{r}

final_dataset <- final_dataset %>%
  mutate(pollen = replace_na(pollen, 0))
# Plot distributions
data_long2 <- final_dataset %>%
  select(avg_pm25, pollen, avg_ppt) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# Plot histograms
ggplot(data_long2, aes(x = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Distributions of PM2.5, Pollen, and Precipitation",
       x = "Value",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()


# Take natural log of each variable, adding a small constant to avoid log(0)
pca <- final_dataset %>%
  mutate(
    ln_pm25 = log(avg_pm25 + 0.1),
    ln_pollen = log(pollen + 0.1),
    ln_ppt = log(avg_ppt + 0.1)
  )


```

## Remove missing rows

```{r}
pca <- pca %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))
```

## Create constituent matrix

```{r}
Constituents0 <- pca %>%
  select(-date, -total_asthma_er, -avg_ppt, -avg_pm25, -pollen)

dim(Constituents0)
summary(Constituents0)
```

## Correlation structure

```{r}
ggcorr(Constituents0)
```

# Principal Components Analysis

```{r}
pca.constituent <- prcomp(Constituents0, scale. = TRUE)

summary(pca.constituent)
```

## Eigenvalues

```{r}
eigenvalues.v <- pca.constituent$sdev^2

perc_variance.v <- eigenvalues.v/sum(eigenvalues.v)
perc_variance.v <- round(100*perc_variance.v,1)

cumulative_perc_var.v <- cumsum(perc_variance.v)

eigenvalues.constituent <- data.frame(
  PC = seq_along(eigenvalues.v),
  Eigenvalue = eigenvalues.v,
  Variance = perc_variance.v,
  Cumulative = cumulative_perc_var.v
)

eigenvalues.constituent
```

## Scree plot

```{r}
fviz_eig(pca.constituent)
```

## PCA Loadings

```{r}
loadings.constituent <- as.data.frame.matrix(pca.constituent$rotation)
loadings.constituent$Constituent <- rownames(loadings.constituent)

loadings.long <- loadings.constituent %>%
  pivot_longer(-Constituent, names_to="PC", values_to="Loading")

loadings.long %>%
  filter(PC %in% c("PC1","PC2", "PC3")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Constituent, Loading)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~PC) +
  theme_bw()
```

## PCA Scores

```{r}
scores.constituent <- as.data.frame(pca.constituent$x)

scores.constituent <- scores.constituent %>%
  select(PC1:PC3)

scores.constituent$date <- pca$date

head(scores.constituent)
```

#Using PC predictors for quasi-poisson regression

```{r}


#join PCA data
# Check for duplicates
pca %>% count(date) %>% filter(n > 1)
scores.constituent %>% count(date) %>% filter(n > 1)

scores.constituent <- scores.constituent %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))

pca <- pca %>%
  left_join(scores.constituent, by = "date")

#create the season confounder variable 
pca <-pca %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(date),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
  ) %>%
  select(-month)

library(MASS)

# Poisson regression (season adjusted)
model <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + season,
             family = poisson(link = "log"),
             data = pca)

summary(model)



# Poisson regression (no season)
model_no_season <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3,
                       family = poisson(link = "log"),
                       data = pca)

summary(model_no_season)

```

#quasi poisson visualization

```{r}

#Quasi-Poisson regression comparison
library(gt)
library(broom)
library(dplyr)

select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter

# Tidy both models
tidy_m1 <- tidy(model_no_season, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(model = "no_season")
tidy_m2 <- tidy(model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(model = "season")

# Wide format: one row per term
comparison_wide <- bind_rows(tidy_m1, tidy_m2) %>%
  select(model, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = model,
    values_from = c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    term = recode(term,
      "(Intercept)"  = "Intercept",
      "PC1"          = "PC1",
      "PC2"          = "PC2",
      "PC3"          = "PC3",
      "seasonSpring" = "Spring",
      "seasonSummer" = "Summer",
      "seasonFall"   = "Fall"
    )
  )

# add sig columns to comparison_wide before gt
comparison_wide <- comparison_wide %>%
  mutate(
    sig_no_season = !is.na(p.value_no_season) & p.value_no_season < 0.05,
    sig_season    = !is.na(p.value_season)    & p.value_season    < 0.05
  )

comparison_wide %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Air Quality, Pollen, and Precipitation Components as Predictors of Daily Asthma Emergency Room Visits: Unadjusted and Season-Adjusted Poisson Regression Models",
    subtitle = "Outcome: Total daily asthma ER visits | Estimates expressed as Incidence Rate Ratios (IRR)"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    term                = "Term",
    estimate_no_season  = "IRR",
    conf.low_no_season  = "95% CI (low)",
    conf.high_no_season = "95% CI (high)",
    p.value_no_season   = "p-value",
    estimate_season     = "IRR",
    conf.low_season     = "95% CI (low)",
    conf.high_season    = "95% CI (high)",
    p.value_season      = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  cols_hide(c(sig_no_season, sig_season)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Model 1: No Season",
              columns = c(estimate_no_season, conf.low_no_season, conf.high_no_season, p.value_no_season)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Model 2: Season Adjusted",
              columns = c(estimate_season, conf.low_season, conf.high_season, p.value_season)) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(estimate_no_season, conf.low_no_season, conf.high_no_season,
                 estimate_season, conf.low_season, conf.high_season),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt(
    columns = c(p.value_no_season, p.value_season),
    fns = function(x) {
      case_when(
        is.na(x)  ~ "—",
        x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        TRUE      ~ formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f")
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = p.value_no_season,
      rows    = sig_no_season == TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = p.value_season,
      rows    = sig_season == TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote("Bold p-values indicate p < 0.05. Season reference category: Winter (Model 2 only).") %>%
  tab_footnote("IRR = Incidence Rate Ratio. Estimates and CIs are exponentiated from log-scale Poisson coefficients.") %>%
  gtsave("regression_comparison.png", vwidth = 1400, expand = 30, zoom = 2)
```

#Sensitvity analysis
```{r}
#temperature variable
temp_daily <- read_csv("daily_temp_nyc.csv") |>
  mutate(
    date     = as.Date(DATE),
    temp_avg = (TMAX / 10 + TMIN / 10) / 2
  ) |>
  select(date, temp_avg)

pca <- pca %>%
  left_join(temp_daily %>% 
              dplyr::select(date, temp_avg) %>% 
              distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE), 
            by = "date")


# Poisson controlling for temperature instead of season
model_temp <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + temp_avg,
                  family = poisson(link = "log"),
                  data = pca)

summary(model_temp)



#Days of the week variable
pca <- pca %>%
  mutate(dow = factor(weekdays(date), 
                      levels = c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", 
                                 "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")))

# Sensitivity: controlling for day of week instead of season
model_dow <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + dow,
                 family = poisson(link = "log"),
                 data = pca)

summary(model_dow)
exp(coef(model_dow))

# Sensitivity controlling for months
pca1 <- pca %>%
  mutate(
    time  = as.numeric(date - min(date)),
    month = factor(month(date), 
                   levels = 1:12, 
                   labels = c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
                              "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"))
  )
model_month  <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + month,
                 family = poisson(link = "log"),
                 data = pca1)
summary(model_month)
model_trend  <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + time,
                 family = poisson(link = "log"),
                 data = pca1)


```

#sensitvity analysis visualization
```{r}

library(gt)
library(broom)
library(dplyr)



# run all sensitivity models
model_temp  <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + temp_avg, family = poisson(link = "log"), data = pca)
model_dow   <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + dow,      family = poisson(link = "log"), data = pca)
model_time  <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + time,     family = poisson(link = "log"), data = pca1)
model_month <- glm(total_asthma_er ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + month,    family = poisson(link = "log"), data = pca1)

# tidy and keep only PC rows
tidy_model <- function(mod, label) {
  tidy(mod, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term %in% c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")) %>%
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
    mutate(model = label)
}

sensitivity_long <- bind_rows(
  tidy_model(model,       "Season"),
  tidy_model(model_temp,  "Temperature"),
  tidy_model(model_dow,   "Day of Week"),
  tidy_model(model_month, "Month")
)

# wide: one row per PC, one set of columns per model
sensitivity_wide <- sensitivity_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = model,
    values_from = c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
  )

# helper to format p-values
fmt_p <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x)  ~ "—",
    x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE       ~ formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "f")
  )
}

# build gt table
sensitivity_wide %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Sensitivity Analysis: Poisson Regression of Daily Asthma ER Visits",
    subtitle = "PC1–PC3 IRRs across alternative confounder adjustments"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Season",      columns = ends_with("Season"))      %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Temperature", columns = ends_with("Temperature")) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Day of Week", columns = ends_with("Day of Week")) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Month",       columns = ends_with("Month"))       %>%
  cols_label(
    term                      = "Term",
    estimate_Season           = "IRR", conf.low_Season           = "95% CI low", conf.high_Season           = "95% CI high", p.value_Season           = "p",
    estimate_Temperature      = "IRR", conf.low_Temperature      = "95% CI low", conf.high_Temperature      = "95% CI high", p.value_Temperature      = "p",
    `estimate_Day of Week`    = "IRR", `conf.low_Day of Week`    = "95% CI low", `conf.high_Day of Week`    = "95% CI high", `p.value_Day of Week`    = "p",
    estimate_Month            = "IRR", conf.low_Month            = "95% CI low", conf.high_Month            = "95% CI high", p.value_Month            = "p"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = starts_with("estimate") | starts_with("conf.low") | starts_with("conf.high"),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt(
    columns = starts_with("p.value"),
    fns     = fmt_p
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_spanners()
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote("IRR = Incidence Rate Ratio. All models include PC1, PC2, PC3. Reference: Season = Winter; Day of Week = Monday.") %>%
  tab_footnote("p-values: <0.001 denoted explicitly; bold indicates p < 0.05.") %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = starts_with("p.value"),
      rows    = (p.value_Season < 0.05           & !is.na(p.value_Season))           |
                (p.value_Temperature < 0.05      & !is.na(p.value_Temperature))      |
                (`p.value_Day of Week` < 0.05    & !is.na(`p.value_Day of Week`))    |
                (p.value_Month < 0.05            & !is.na(p.value_Month))
    )
  ) %>%
  gtsave("sensitivity_analysis.png", 
       vwidth = 2400,
       vheight = 900,
       expand = 30,
       zoom = 2)

# confounder significance table
tidy_confounders <- bind_rows(
  tidy(model,       exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Season"),
  tidy(model_temp,  exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Temperature"),
  tidy(model_dow,   exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Day of Week"),
  tidy(model_month, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Month")
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!term %in% c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "(Intercept)")) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_fmt = fmt_p(p.value))

tidy_confounders %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "model") %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Sensitivity Analysis: Confounder Term Significance",
    subtitle = "IRRs for confounder variables across all sensitivity models"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    term      = "Term",
    estimate  = "IRR",
    conf.low  = "95% CI low",
    conf.high = "95% CI high",
    p.value   = "p-value",
    p_fmt     = "p (formatted)"
  ) %>%
  cols_hide(p.value) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), decimals = 3) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = p_fmt,
      rows    = p.value < 0.05 & !is.na(p.value)
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote("Bold p-values indicate p < 0.05. IRR = Incidence Rate Ratio.") %>%
  gtsave("sensitivity_confounders.png", vwidth = 1200, vheight = 1600, expand = 30, zoom = 2)

```

```{r}

tidy_all <- bind_rows(
  tidy(model,       exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Season"),
  tidy(model_temp,  exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Temperature"),
  tidy(model_dow,   exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Day of Week"),
  tidy(model_month, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Month")
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  dplyr::select(model, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%

    term = recode(term,
      "PC1"            = "PC1",
      "PC2"            = "PC2",
      "PC3"            = "PC3",

tidy_all %>%
  dplyr::select(model, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, p_fmt) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "model") %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Sensitivity Analysis: Poisson Regression of Daily Asthma ER Visits",

  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    term      = "Term",
    estimate  = "IRR",

    locations = cells_row_groups()

  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),

  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = p_fmt,
      rows    = p.value < 0.05 & !is.na(p.value)
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote("IRR = Incidence Rate Ratio. Reference categories: Season = Winter; Day of Week = Monday; Month = January.") %>%
  tab_footnote("Bold p-values indicate p < 0.05.") %>%
  gtsave("sensitivity_analysis_full.png", vwidth = 1000, vheight = 3000, expand = 30, zoom = 2)
```
